name: Exp_XROC2_VG_X2
summary: This EA is a dual-indicator momentum trading system that uses XROC2 (Rate of Change) and VG (Volume Gain) indicators across two timeframes to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when both momentum indicators confirm upward movement and short positions when they confirm downward movement, with built-in position management and exit logic.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个双指标动量交易系统，使用XROC2（变化率）和VG（成交量增益）指标在两个时间周期上生成交易信号。当两个动量指标同时确认向上运动时做多，确认向下运动时做空，内置仓位管理和出场逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于XROC2（双周期变化率）和VG（成交量增益）两个动量指标的组合信号进行交易，属于多周期动量策略。入场条件要求两个指标在不同时间框架上同向确认，XROC2衡量价格变化速度而VG衡量成交量方向性动量，两者结合过滤假信号。出场条件采用固定止损和止盈，同时包含持仓时间限制和反向信号平仓机制。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金的动态仓位计算，允许用户选择不同的仓位模式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓数限制和单笔风险控制，但缺乏整体账户回撤保护。策略的核心优势在于双指标多时间框架确认机制能有效过滤噪声信号，但对市场 regime 切换的适应性有限。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA trades based on combined signals from XROC2 (dual-period Rate of Change) and VG (Volume Gain) momentum indicators, constituting a multi-timeframe momentum strategy. Entry conditions require both indicators to confirm the same direction across different timeframes — XROC2 measures price change velocity while VG measures volume directional momentum, and their combination filters out false signals. Exit conditions employ fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, along with position time limits and reverse-signal closing mechanisms. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and equity-based dynamic calculation, allowing users to select different sizing modes. Money management provides maximum position count limits and per-trade risk control, but lacks overall account drawdown protection. The core advantage of the strategy is that the dual-indicator multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism effectively filters noisy signals, but adaptability to market regime shifts is limited.

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade of total capital

pros: 双指标多时间框架确认机制有效过滤假信号，提高入场质量
XROC2与VG结合兼顾价格动量和成交量动量，信号更可靠
提供固定手数和资金管理两种仓位模式，灵活性较好
内置止损止盈和最大持仓数限制，基础风险控制到位
多周期确认减少震荡市中的频繁开仓
pros_en: Dual-indicator multi-timeframe confirmation effectively filters false signals and improves entry quality
Combining XROC2 with VG covers both price momentum and volume momentum for more reliable signals
Offers both fixed lot and money management position sizing modes for good flexibility
Built-in stop-loss, take-profit, and maximum position limits provide solid basic risk control
Multi-timeframe confirmation reduces frequent opening in choppy markets
cons: 缺乏整体账户回撤保护机制，极端行情下可能连续亏损
未包含点差过滤，在短线操作或高点差品种上滑点成本较高
动量策略在震荡市中容易产生连续假信号导致反复止损
持仓时间限制机制可能导致在趋势未结束时过早平仓
指标参数固定缺乏自适应调整能力，不同市场环境需手动优化
cons_en: Lacks overall account drawdown protection, risking consecutive losses in extreme market conditions
No spread filter included, leading to high slippage costs on short-term trades or high-spread instruments
Momentum strategies tend to generate consecutive false signals in ranging markets causing repeated stop-outs
Position time limit may cause premature exits before trends fully develop
Fixed indicator parameters lack adaptive adjustment, requiring manual optimization for different market environments
improvements: 增加账户级最大回撤保护，当回撤超过阈值时暂停交易
加入点差过滤和市场波动率自适应机制，在高点差或低波动环境下减少交易频率
为指标参数添加自适应优化逻辑，根据近期市场特征动态调整周期参数
improvements_en: Add account-level maximum drawdown protection to pause trading when drawdown exceeds a threshold
Implement spread filtering and market volatility adaptation to reduce trading frequency in high-spread or low-volatility environments
Add adaptive optimization logic for indicator parameters to dynamically adjust periods based on recent market characteristics

risk_points: 缺少账户级回撤保护，连续亏损可能造成较大资金损失
未设置点差过滤，高点差环境下入场成本不可控
动量策略在趋势反转时反应滞后，可能承受较大回撤
risk_points_en: No account-level drawdown protection, consecutive losses may cause significant capital damage
No spread filter means entry costs are uncontrolled in high-spread environments
Momentum strategy reacts with lag at trend reversals, potentially enduring large drawdowns

It enters long positions when both momentum indicators confirm upward movement and short positions when they confirm downward movement, with built-in position management and exit logic.
